pages.text: The paleogourd is a curious crop recently uncovered by the sniffer. Its thick roots stabilize nearby soil, preventing trampling and erosion. The largest specimens create vast root networks, securing blocks up to 5 blocks away!
While the fruit is safe to eat, it has a grainy texture and tastes strongly of salt. It is better used as a brewing ingredient in the potion of fortitude which reduces damage taken by 20%.
The fruit can be processed into more seeds.
The seeds can be processed into brown dye.
